top_signals.title: South Korea Says Market Measures Will Ease Investor Jitters
top_signals.summary: South Korea’s finance minister said the government’s latest market-stabilization measures should help restore investor confidence, even as the benchmark Kospi slumped another 5% on Monday following last week’s selloff.

top_signals.title: India’s Appeal Grows as Global Tech Selloff Deepens
top_signals.summary: India’s appeal as an anti-AI market is growing as the global tech selloff deepens. From stocks to the currency, Indian assets are drawing fresh foreign interest as several tailwinds fall into place. Bloomberg’s Abhishek Vishnoi explains what to watch this week. (Source: Bloomberg)
